reviewItem.question: Does "loki Deprecate write dedupe cache as this is not required by the newer single store indexes (tsdb and boltdb-shipper)" mean a change to config-key:loki|path=write_dedupe_cache (deprecated)?

proposed.statement: The write dedupe cache configuration is deprecated in Loki 3.0.0 as it is not required by newer single store indexes (tsdb and boltdb-shipper).
